title: ‘OP Sindoor Was Just a Trailer’: Army Chief Warns Pakistan After Delhi Blast
description: Chief of Army Staff General Upendra Dwivedi delivered a strong message while speaking about Operation Sindoor, calling the 88-hour mission “just a trailer” and asserting that the Indian Army is fully prepared for any future challenge. He warned that if Pakistan creates an opportunity, India will “teach it how to behave responsibly with a neighbouring nation.” The Army Chief highlighted that modern warfare has shifted to multi-domain battles, where the duration of conflict cannot be predicted and long-term preparedness is essential.
